{{Youmay|a spacer|[[Fenn (disambiguation)|other uses of the name]]}}
'''Fenn''' was a burly [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who once had his pocket picked during a visit to the [[Dancing Dewback]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. The thief, a child named [[Cev Rees]], melted into the cantina crowd, slipping Fenn's wallet into the hands of his companion, a pilot named [[Rhen]]. Rhen claimed he had dropped it, and offered Fenn a drink in order to avoid any possible confrontation with the spacer.<ref name="TRG">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>
